help.emergency_body: اتصل بخدمات الطوارئ فوراً: 112 (الاتحاد الأوروبي) أو 911 (أمريكا/كندا). كل ثانية مهمة.
help.disclaimer: Queer Guide لا يغني عن المساعدة المهنية.

help.reveal_aria: انقر في أي مكان لإظهار الصفحة من جديد
help.hidden_hint: الصفحة مخفية. انقر في أي مكان لإظهارها.
help.expect_1: You'll hear a short greeting. You don't have to give your name.
help.expect_2: You can hang up at any time. You can call back as often as you need.
help.expect_3: Free hotlines in DE/AT/CH don't appear on itemized phone bills.
help.expect_4: If you can't speak, ask for text or chat — most hotlines offer it.
help.self_help_desc: Short techniques you can use while you wait, or instead of a call if you're not ready.
help.breathing_1: Breathe in through your nose for 4 seconds.
help.breathing_3: Breathe out through your mouth for 8 seconds.
help.grounding_intro: Name, out loud or in your head:
help.safety_plan_desc: A short written plan you can pull up when things get bad — your warning signs, coping steps, people to call, and reasons to live.
help.report_aria: Report a problem with this hotline
help.report_desc: Thanks for helping keep this list accurate. Reports are reviewed by our team.
help.closed_no_alt: هذا الخط مغلق الآن ولا يوجد لدينا خط آخر مفتوح لهذا البلد. في حالة الخطر الفوري، استخدم رقم الطوارئ أعلاه.
help.directories_subtitle: هذه أدلة ومنظمات إحالة — مواقع إلكترونية، وليست خطوط هاتف مباشرة.
help.helping_body: إذا كنت تصغي إلى شخص يمرّ بأزمة: ابقَ معه، وخذ ما يقوله على محمل الجدّ، ولا تتركه وحده. لست مضطرًا لامتلاك الإجابات. اتصلا معًا بأحد الخطوط، أو اتصل أنت لتسأل عمّا ينبغي فعله.
help.know_the_law_body: إمكانية العيش بصراحة أو طلب الرعاية الصحية أو الإبلاغ عن جريمة بأمان تعتمد على مكان وجودك. تحقّق من الوضع القانوني قبل أن تتصرّف.

help.no_country_body: اختر بلدًا من الأعلى وسنعرض لك الخط الأنسب. جميع الخطوط مدرجة في الأسفل.

help.no_police_policy: يعلن هذا الخط أنه لا يتصل بالشرطة أو خدمات الطوارئ أبدًا دون طلب صريح منك.
help.org_coverage: هذا الدليل بعيد عن الاكتمال. إذا كانت هناك جهة تثق بها وغير مدرجة، أخبرنا. النتيجة الفارغة تعني أنه لا سجلّ لدينا، لا أنّ المساعدة غير موجودة.

hidden-lives.title: [AR] Hidden lives
hidden-lives.intro: قبل عام 1800 نجت الحياة الكويرية في ظل القانون والكنيسة. ما حفظه السجل هو الاضطهاد في معظمه: محاكمات وإعدامات ومراسيم. وإلى جانبه لمحات نادرة من حب ومجتمع بقيت بعده.

empire-criminalization.title: [AR] Empire & criminalization
empire-criminalization.intro: [AR] Colonial empires exported sodomy laws across the globe in the 19th century, while a few states — revolutionary France first among them — quietly removed their own. Much of today's legal map was drawn in this era.

birth-of-movement.title: [AR] Birth of a movement
birth-of-movement.intro: [AR] Between the 1860s and the early 1930s the first words, organizations and campaigns emerged: Kertbeny coined 'homosexual', Hirschfeld founded the first gay rights organization, and Berlin briefly became the queer capital of the world.

destruction.title: [AR] Destruction
destruction.intro: [AR] Fascism destroyed the first movement. The Nazis burned Hirschfeld's institute, tightened Paragraph 175 and deported thousands of gay men to concentration camps. Remembering this era is part of why this timeline exists.

homophile-years.title: [AR] The homophile years
homophile-years.intro: بعد الحرب أعادت جماعات «هوموفيلية» صغيرة البناء بهدوء: ماتاشين، وبنات بيليتيس، وأركادي، وCOC. استبدلت الراديكالية بالاحترام الاجتماعي بينما استمرت المداهمات وحملات التطهير.

liberation.title: [AR] Liberation

body.source: كل وضع قانوني على هذا الموقع مصدره قاعدة بيانات ILGA World، وهي المجموعة المرجعية التي تديرها الرابطة الدولية للمثليات والمثليين ومزدوجي التوجه الجنسي والعابرين وثنائيي الجنس. ويشمل ذلك التجريم، والاعتراف بالشراكة، والحماية من التمييز، والاعتراف بالنوع الاجتماعي، والعلاج التحويلي، وسلامة الجسد لثنائيي الجنس.
body.refresh: [AR] We re-import it nightly. Where a country page shows an "Updated" date, that is the date ILGA last revised that record, not the date we fetched it.
body.unscored: [AR] The unscored rows are uninhabited or near-uninhabited territories with no ILGA entry. We list them as "not scored" rather than giving them a default, because a default would read as a measurement.
body.scoreHow: [AR] The score runs 0–100. It starts at 50 and moves up or down as each recorded right is added: decriminalisation and marriage weigh heaviest, then anti-discrimination protections, hate-crime law, adoption, legal gender recognition and a conversion-therapy ban.
body.scoreLimit: [AR] Because it opens at 50 and adds from there, a country we hold almost nothing about lands mid-scale rather than reading as unknown. A middling score can mean middling rights or thin data, and the number cannot tell you which.
body.scoreLens: [AR] It is also a single number for very different lives. Protections are recorded separately for sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression and sex characteristics, and those four rarely move together — a country can protect sexual orientation thoroughly and gender identity not at all. Read the per-right breakdown on a country page rather than the score alone.
body.scoreNotSafety: [AR] The score describes law on paper. It is not a safety rating, and it says nothing about enforcement, policing or how welcome you will be made to feel.

limits.national: البيانات وطنية المستوى. وحين تختلف الحقوق بين ولاية وأخرى، كما في الولايات المتحدة وإندونيسيا ونيجيريا والمكسيك، يخفي الرقم الوطني الواحد هذا الاختلاف.
limits.enforcement: [AR] It records statutes, not enforcement. A law that is rarely applied and a law applied constantly look identical here.
limits.trans: [AR] Several facts that matter most to trans travellers are not in this dataset at all: bathroom and facility access, how identity documents are treated at borders, and access to gender-affirming healthcare.
limits.personal: [AR] It knows nothing about you. Your citizenship, residency, gender marker and relationship status all change what applies, and we hold none of them.
limits.corrections: [AR] If something here is wrong, tell us — corrections to the underlying record should also go to ILGA, who maintain it.

story.title: كيف بدأ هذا
story.p1: العثور على حانة صديقة للكويريين لا ينبغي أن يحتاج إلى مجموعة دردشة وثلاثة نقاشات في منتدى وقفزة في المجهول. بدأنا Queer Guide لأننا تعبنا من التخمين: أي الأماكن آمنة فعلاً، وأيّها يكتفي بوضع قوس قزح على شعاره في يونيو.
story.p2: قائمة شخصية بأماكن موثوقة تحوّلت إلى دليل عالمي: يتحقّق منه المجتمع، ومبني على تجارب حقيقية، ومجاني. سواء كنت تسافر وحدك أو تنتقل إلى مدينة جديدة أو تبحث فقط عن مكان لليلة الجمعة — ابدأ من هنا.

fourLines.title: [AR] Four lines
fourLines.caption: [AR] Gender identity, gender expression, sex assigned at birth and attraction are four separate lines. Pick a stop on each. Nothing is stored or sent.
fourLines.summary: [AR] A transit map with four lines: gender identity drawn as two independent services on one corridor, gender expression, sex assigned at birth as a terminus that runs on to nothing, and attraction. They meet at a single interchange.
fourLines.readout: [AR] Where you are on each line
fourLines.tableCaption: [AR] Every line on the map and the stops it carries

help.identityWoman: [AR] Who you know yourself to be. This runs independently of the line below it. You can be a lot of both, a little of both, or neither.
help.identityMan: [AR] The second rail on the same corridor. Answering this one does not subtract from the one above.
help.expression: [AR] How you present: clothes, voice, hair, the way you carry yourself. Stops, not a scale. Nothing here is halfway between two others.
help.assigned: [AR] What someone wrote down when you were born. It is a starting point on the record, which is why this line stops instead of running on to the others.
help.attraction: [AR] Who you are drawn to. Who you are and who you are drawn to are separate lines. That is the whole point of the map.

consentFlow.title: [AR] The line that stops
consentFlow.caption: [AR] Consent as a route with signals, one speed restriction and no final destination. It loops back to the check-in and stays there. Not a legal test; the law differs by country.
consentFlow.summary: [AR] A branching line. Asking without an answer, and anything that is not a clear yes, end at buffer stops. Capacity is a hatched speed-restriction section rather than a yes/no signal. The line does not terminate in approval. It loops back to a check-in signal that can be answered again at any time.
consentFlow.tableCaption: [AR] Every stop on the line, and where it leads
consentFlow.hint: [AR] Select any stop to light up the route that reaches it.

node.start: [AR] You want to do something with someone
node.clearYes: [AR] Was the answer a clear yes?
node.capacity: [AR] Speed restriction: can everyone actually decide?

note.asked: [AR] Out loud, or in a way you have both already agreed reads as asking.
note.notAsked: [AR] Not objecting is not agreeing. The line does not start here.
note.clearYes: [AR] Theirs, not one you talked them into.
note.notAYes: [AR] Anything that is not a yes is a no. This is the end of the line.
note.capacity: [AR] Drink, drugs, exhaustion, being half asleep. Not a switch. If you cannot tell, you do not have an answer yet.
note.checkin: [AR] The signal you come back to. Agreeing earlier is not agreeing now.
note.stopNow: [AR] Anyone can stop anything at any point, for no reason. Then look after each other.
note.go: [AR] And back to the check-in, which is why this line is a loop.
